intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Seminole for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from December 6 (the free Seminole Holiday Light Parade on 113th Street N) through December 19 (Breakfast with Santa at the Seminole City Park Parkview Room, $8), with Winterfest at the Seminole Recreation Center (December 11, $7 activity band) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Seminole

  • 3 Christmas events for kids in Seminole
  • 1 free event: the Seminole Holiday Light Parade (December 6)
  • Meet Santa: the Santa meet and greet at Winterfest (December 11) and Breakfast with Santa (December 19, two seatings)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Seminole Holiday Light Parade (Sunday, December 6, 6 to 8 pm)
  • Trains: none in town; see the Largo page for the Rudolph Limited
  • Season: December 6 to December 19

Planning a bigger day out? Seminole families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Tampa, which covers Busch Gardens Christmas Town, ZooTampa Lights and the Tampa Riverwalk boat parade.
